comment: Hold position (H) of the units that hold by their own orders (GetHoldPositionOrder 0x41fae0): a Queen (QueenHoldPosition, 108), a Scourge and an Infested Terran (SuicideHoldPosition, 136). The Queen is held, then given a Shift-queued move (the held order activates the queue); the Scourge and the Infested Terran are box-selected, held with an enemy Wraith 200 pixels away (they must not chase), then a Shift-queued move follows.
